question: How many restaurants in India can use POS software?
idealClarificationQuestions: Restaurants needing/using POS (Point of Sale) system: order management + billing + inventory + analytics? Yes.
Addressable: dine-in restaurants (excludes home kitchens, fast-food single-vendors)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total Indian restaurants (with seating + structure): ~25-30 lakh.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Of these, with revenue >₹15L/year (POS economic threshold): ~6-7 lakh.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Annual ARPU for restaurant POS: ~₹15,000-25,000 (basic) to ~₹2L (advanced with inventory + KOT).

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Of these, formal/organized restaurants (not roadside stalls)
Of these, with revenue >₹15L/year (POS economic threshold)
Currently using any POS / billing software

calculationFlow: Total Indian restaurants (with seating + structure): ~25-30 lakh.
Of these, formal/organized restaurants (not roadside stalls): ~12 lakh.
Of these, with revenue >₹15L/year (POS economic threshold): ~6-7 lakh.
Currently using any POS / billing software: ~40% = ~2.6 lakh.
TAM for restaurant POS software: ~6-7 lakh.
Annual ARPU for restaurant POS: ~₹15,000-25,000 (basic) to ~₹2L (advanced with inventory + KOT).
